name: motion-queue-compress
title: Live Queue Compression
description: Ô đầu hàng chạy thanh xử lý, xong thì xanh lên, bay lên và mờ đi, sau đó các ô còn lại lần lượt dồn lên bằng lò xo.

moworks.author: moworks

options.items: selector of the queue cards, first first

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: 4 slots (50 x 44, 64 px pitch). Item 01: progress bar fills 400-1100 ms easeInOut, turns green at 1100; exits 1300-1600 ms ease-in cubic, y -40 px + fade. Then items 02-04 each shift one slot left on a spring (stiffness 240, damping 24), starting 1650 + 60 i ms; counter n = 4 -> 3 at 1600 ms. Order matters: the exit finishes before the shift starts. Params: process (0.7 s) · exit (0.3 s) · spring (240 / 24) · stagger (60 ms). Order matters: the finished card has left before the others move up.
moworks.titleVi: Hàng đợi dồn lên sau khi xong việc
